name: Repurchase Agreement 2
definition: Agreement between two parties to sell a financial instrument or set of financial instruments and repurchase at an agreed later date.

MaturityDate.name: Maturity Date
MaturityDate.definition: Date on which the repurchase agreement matures.

SecondLegPrice.name: Second Leg Price
SecondLegPrice.definition: Specifies the repurchase price at maturity of the repo.

CollateralMarketValue.name: Collateral Market Value
CollateralMarketValue.definition: Specifies the dirty price of the underlying security or securities in repo.

Counterparty.name: Counterparty
Counterparty.definition: Identifies the counterparty to the repurchase agreement.

RepurchaseAgreementType.name: Repurchase Agreement Type
RepurchaseAgreementType.definition: Specifies the type of repurchase agreement.
